description: Walk an address's INCOMING funds backwards to answer 'where did this wallet's money come from'. Stops at labelled entities (exchanges, mixers, services) and reports them with hop distance. Answers source-of-funds questions. Read-only: it only reads on-chain history.

address.description: The address whose funding to trace.

chain.description: Blockchain: bitcoin, ethereum, bsc or tron.

max_hops.description: How far back to walk. Default set by the API.

name: trace_source_of_funds
title: Trace where funds came from
